_source: Unseen launchers that rain an attack on fixed spots while the party is near them, by territory. Each: the launcher BNpc (layout ID), the action it casts, the times between casts (one picked at random each time), how near a party member (player, Duty Support or Player NPC) must be to one of its spots for it to go on (yalms, across the ground), and the spots retail cast it at (ActorCast positions). It never casts within 6 yalms of the spot before (219 of 220 casts in retail). Castrum Meridianum (1043): BNpcBase 6358 (44 HP, no HOSTILE flag), 29154 (a 2.7 s cast) every 4.9 or 5.9 s (117 and 100 of the times between casts), on the spots below, in all five retail runs (Bob's and Connor's captures: 15-9ba7d981, 15-50e72631, 15-af05916c and two of release 1's); each launcher began within 3 s of the player coming within 12 yalms of its spots and went on while someone was (Bob's mark of 2026-11-21 at (-30.59, 64.90, 235.51): "no random AOE fall in this area like in retail"; Kawari had them stand idle).
